subject.title: fix: recover final replies after settled tool-only turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this one-shot, tool-disabled continuation as the shared default for settled post-tool empty terminal turns across providers and channels?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes global agent-runtime recovery semantics after completed side effects; source tests establish the mechanical guard, but accepting the provider-cost and behavior policy needs an owner decision.

options.title: Accept the bounded recovery
options.body: Merge after normal CI if the agent-runtime owner agrees that one final tool-disabled provider request is the correct cross-channel default.

options.title: Narrow the eligibility
options.body: Keep the fix open but require a stricter owner-defined terminal-state or provider eligibility boundary before allowing side-effecting settled turns to recover.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded recovery
recommendation.body: Merge after normal CI if the agent-runtime owner agrees that one final tool-disabled provider request is the correct cross-channel default.

likelyOwner.reason: The related prior design discussion identifies him as the person who set direction on keeping this terminal-recovery problem structurally narrow.
